description: The linked reader's taste: the books, authors, series, genres and moods they love, what they avoid or quit, and why each counts, in their own words where they gave them. The basis for "what should I read next", "recommend me a book" and "what kind of books do I like" when no book or mood is named. Returns the strongest 40 entries; limit raises that. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

limit.description: Most steering entries to return, strongest first
